input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier undertaking binds Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. The licence grant (§ 2) is expressly non-exclusive; the use restrictions in § 3 are limited to copying, assignment, reverse engineering and third-party protection and contain no requirements-purchase or no-third-party-procurement covenant; the maintenance provisions (§ 10, § 10(a)-(b)) impose services obligations on Garman rather than a sole-source obligation on Sparkling; and searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "compete" and prohibitory operators return no sourcing restriction. Sparkling therefore remains free to buy routing software or support from other suppliers, which satisfies the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer). No redline required.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
